_readme: Live pointer, read at page load. Edit on the server and refresh — no rebuild needed. There are only two sources: the roster behind rosterApiUrl for login, and the one spreadsheet in sheetId for everything a parent reads.
_rosterApiUrl: SOURCE 1 — login. /api/lookup is the Netlify function. Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and ROSTER_CSV_URL — and ADMIN_EMAILS for staff — in the SERVER environment. It accepts nothing but a Google ID token: an email address posted to it is refused.
_sheetId: SOURCE 2 — everything else. Share link of the single spreadsheet holding the trip content. Needs 'Anyone with the link → Viewer'. Leave blank if you are using publishedId instead.
_publishedId: SOURCE 2, the private-document route. Paste the File → Share → Publish to web link (it contains /d/e/2PACX-…). The spreadsheet itself stays Restricted; only this read-only snapshot is public. Wins over sheetId. Tabs are addressed by gid here, not by name, so put each tab's gid in 'gids' — with none set, the first tab is served.
_csvBase: Local CSV files instead of Google, for development only. Blank in production.
_gids: Only needed if a tab has been renamed — a gid survives renames and wins over the tab name.
_driveApiKey: Optional. Turns a Drive FOLDER link inside a Documents row into one card per file. Not a content source on its own.
_adminEmails: Leave empty. Staff are configured via ADMIN_EMAILS in the server environment — this file is public, and there is no reason to publish which addresses unlock every grade. A listed address still has to arrive with a verified Google token for that address.
_tripPhotos: The school's own photograph of each grade's trip, shown on the Overview tab with the sheet's Header Text over it. Keyed by grade id. PREFERRED: paste the Drive share link of the photo (Share → Anyone with the link → Viewer, then Copy link) — the app turns it into Drive's thumbnail URL itself and Drive resizes it to the width each place renders, so the school's bandwidth bill stays off the site's host and nobody has to hand-build a URL. A local file in public/trip-photos/ or any other public image URL still works and is passed through untouched. A link that is NOT shared 'anyone with the link' returns a sign-in page instead of an image; the banner catches that and falls back to the grade colour, so a wrongly-shared photo looks like no photo rather than a broken one — open the link in a private window to check. A grade with no entry shows no photograph — nothing is searched for and no stock image is substituted, because a picture of a place reads to a parent as a picture of their child's trip. NOTE: anything listed here is served publicly and is NOT behind the parent login, so adding a photograph of students is a publishing decision, not a configuration one. The g7 entry was published on 2026-08-17 on the school's instruction, with parental consent confirmed as on file.
_tripCardPhotos: The photograph on the grade card in the picker, keyed by grade id. Optional: a grade with no entry here uses its tripPhotos image, and with neither it keeps the grade's colour and icon. It exists separately because the card is a wide 2.6:1 strip while the trip page's banner fills the window, so the same file rarely crops well in both. Served publicly and not behind the login, exactly like tripPhotos, and takes a Drive share link the same way — fetched at 1200px wide here against the banner's 1600px, because the card is only a 132px strip.
_slidePreviews: Published Google Slides decks shown LIVE on the trip page — Safety and Do's and don'ts on the Itinerary tab, Things to carry on its own tab. Paste the File → Share → Publish to web link; /pub and /embed are both accepted and /pub is rewritten to /embed, which is the same snapshot sized to fit its frame. Because this frames the published document rather than an exported image, an edit staff make in Slides appears on the next page load — nothing to redraw, no deploy. Keys are FLAT '<gradeId>.<section>' strings where section is safety, dodont or carry; do NOT nest them, because config merging walks one level and would stringify a nested object. Keyed per grade so one grade's parents are never shown another grade's safety deck. A section with no entry here falls back to the sheet's own card or text. CHECK EACH LINK OPENS THE DECK ITS KEY NAMES: these three were pasted one position rotated (fixed 2026-08-17), so Safety showed the do-and-donts deck, Do/Dont showed things-to-carry and Things to carry showed safety. Open the published URL and read its title.
_googleClientId: OAuth 2.0 Web client id. REQUIRED — Google Sign-In is the only way into this app, so with this blank nobody can sign in and the login page says so. Set it and One Tap signs a returning parent in with no click. The SAME id must also be set as GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in the server environment, which is where the token is actually verified; the two must match or every sign-in is refused.
